2.name: Episode 1
2.overview: Following the events of the previous season, Rupert shelters Cameron whilst Tony, having survived his injury, seeks justice. A polo match takes place with both Corinium and Venturer filming for broadcast. Despite pressure from Tony, Cameron sides with Rupert. Tony promises revenge.

2.name: Episode 2
2.overview: Rupert launches his General Election campaign and struggles to balance public ambition and tensions at home. Sarah's career hangs in the balance when Tony pressures her while Venturer is pressured by Corinium.

2.name: Episode 3
2.overview: A scandalous Corinium exposé sends shockwaves through Rutshire and Westminster and Rupert faces mounting pressure on election day over the future of his political career. Declan and Venturer reel from the fallout. As Venturer’s future is threatened, Tony exploits their growing divisions and Rupert is forced to confront the true cost of the scandal.

2.name: Episode 4
2.overview: Maud returns to Rutshire, igniting fury from Declan as Tony draws her into Corinium. Rupert tries to find a way forward, only for old sins to resurface. Venturer land a lucky break, but as A Midsummer Night’s Dream descends into chaos, Tony seduces Maud with the promise of stardom and her spellbinding turn as Titania makes it clear that ambition comes with a greater cost than she bargained for.

2.name: Episode 5
2.overview: In Ireland, Declan clashes with Cameron as his marriage unravels. Back home, Rupert turns disgrace into opportunity, securing a prime time slot for Venturer. While Monica withdraws, Tony doubles down on his desire for power and control while Declan and Cameron discover the true limits of a professional working relationship. As Venturer battle for the Golden Gauntlet, who will emerge victorious?

2.name: Episode 6
2.overview: A storm descends on Rutshire as a sordid secret is exposed and the night takes a dark turn.

overview: سال ۱۹۸۶ است و بریتانیا در حال شکوفایی است. «رقیبان» با سر به دنیای بی‌رحم تلویزیون شیرجه می‌زند، جایی که آرایش مو رایج و جاه‌طلبی‌ها حتی بزرگ‌تر هستند. معاملات در اتاق‌های هیئت مدیره و همچنین اتاق‌های خواب انجام می‌شود. هیچ‌کس نمی‌تواند مطمئن باشد که چه کسی پیروز خواهد شد. در حالی که هر زن و مردی فقط به فکر خودشان هستند، آیا عشق واقعی می‌تواند واقعاً شکوفا شود؟

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: The battle for the Central South West television franchise reaches a fever pitch as the war between Corinium and Venturer enters a dangerous new phase. More ruthless than ever, Tony Baddingham is determined to dismantle his rivals piece-by-piece, weaponising scandal and manipulating those closest to him to maintain his grip on power.

title: Rivals
